summary: WorksheetAssignStudentsEditAll is a web page and user control in the HSPnet system used for managing the assignment of students to worksheet groups, courses, and destinations. It supports both group and individual workflows, adapting its controls and functionality depending on query parameters and user session. It provides a paginated, editable grid view of student assignments, with workflow controls for sorting, filtering, and batch editing. The system leverages ASP.NET controls, resources, and session state for dynamic rendering and state management.
purpose: To allow administrators or coordinators to assign students to courses, sections, groups, and destination placements, supporting both group and individual assignment modes. The page provides workflow for searching, sorting, filtering, batch editing, and confirming assignments. It also handles validation, error, and warning messaging.

business_rules: GroupFlag determines if assignment is in group or individual mode, switching context and search logic.
Confirmed students cannot be reassigned; assignment controls hidden.
Sorting and filtering options depend on query parameters and session state.
Assignment block visibility depends on CourseUsesBlocks and GroupFlag.
AssignmentSortOrder determines which field is used for sorting assignment options.
validations: ValidationSummary control displays field and form validation errors.
Confirmed assignments are protected from reassignment.
Dropdown values must be valid assignment or separator rows.
Certain fields required depending on query and session state.
calculations: Paging: StartRow, PageSize, TotalCount used to calculate page indices and display record counts.
Block assignment logic: Block is parsed from dropdown value or set based on context.
AssignmentSortOrder sets displayed label and order.
conditions: If GroupFlag is true, group context and search methods are used; otherwise, individual context.
If CourseUsesBlocks is true and Block > 0, block controls and values are shown.
If ShowConfirmed is true, confirmed students are displayed but cannot be reassigned.
system_behavior: Page binds controls and fields dynamically based on session and query parameters.
Assignment changes are batch processed; errors/warnings handled via panels.
Redirects or refreshes triggered by Save/Cancel/EditNext commands.
JavaScript variables dynamically registered based on grid state.
dependencies: WorksheetGroups and WorksheetAssignedStudents for assignment logic.
ASP.NET WebForms grid view and controls.
HSPnet global resources for label text.
exceptions: If UUID parsing fails, assignment search may not work.
If UserSession is null, assignment operations are cancelled.
Assignment update may trigger warnings/errors based on business rules.
